text:
sam: FYI getting multiple reports that token-cost dashboard shows $0 for a subset of orgs since ~03:00 UTC. customer ticket 4521 and internal spike alert.

maya: I can see the spike, thanks. Which orgs?

sam: org ids 1124, 2201, 3387 — all on EU region. Screenshot attached in ticket.

eli: ran a quick check, aggregate rows exist but cost_amount is null for those orgs in hourly_rollups.

maya: any recent deploys to billing/ingest?

julian: deployment at 02:50 for rate-limiter backoff patch (billing-ingest service). Rollout was canary -> 100% around 03:05.

eli: logs show consumer error at 03:02: "failed to write rollup: negative-quantity -> skipping" repeatedly, then consumer restarted.

sam: could the consumer have skipped processing events leaving zeros?

maya: possible. If the rollup job wrote rows with null cost_amount, UI will show $0 / NaN.

julian: checking commit diff — we added a guard that drops events with qty<=0 instead of converting to 0. bug if quantity calculation returns NaN.

ops-bot: incident created: INC-2026, assigned to eng-billing.

eli: repro steps locally: ingest synthetic events with malformed price meta -> aggregator emits cost_amount = NaN in Parquet -> DB ingest writes NULL. attaching snippet:

```
# simplified repro
emit_event({"org":1124, "tokens": 0/0, "price": 0.02})
# aggregator does float ops -> NaN
```

maya: good find. So root cause is bad numeric handling in aggregator + new guard that dropped non-positive but didn't sanitize NaN.

sam: mitigation? rollback rate-limiter patch?

julian: we should not rollback whole deploy. Quick fix: patch aggregator to coalesce NaN -> 0 and re-run backfill for affected hours. I'll cut a hotfix now.

eli: I can kick off a targeted backfill for the org list. estimate 45m to run and validate.

maya: schedule it during low-traffic window. Also add a UI-level fallback to show "missing" instead of $0 while we fix.

sam: customer comms: I'll message ticket owner that we're investigating and ETA ~1h.

julian: hotfix PR opened: handleNaN -> Number.isFinite check before writing. patch applied to canary at 03:30. monitoring...

ops-bot: deploy succeeded for billing-aggregator at 03:31.

eli: backfill job started at 03:40 for hours 02:00-04:00 for orgs [1124,2201,3387]. job id bf-889.

maya: after first 10m, metrics show one org fixed (1124) — cost restored. others queued.

sam: noted customer 4521 updated. thanks.

eli: backfill completed at 04:12. validation script:
```
SELECT org_id, hour, SUM(cost_amount) FROM hourly_rollups
WHERE org_id IN (1124,2201,3387) AND hour BETWEEN '2026-03-15 02:00' AND '2026-03-15 04:00'
GROUP BY org_id, hour;
```
all non-null now.

maya: closing incident once we verify no other orgs affected. running wider scan for NaN rows.

julian: scan results: ~0.02% of hourly rows had non-finite cost in EU shard during 02:45-03:10. all fixed by backfill. adding regression test to block NaN writes.

sam: postmortem items?

maya: 1) fix aggregator NaN handling (done). 2) add metric alert for non-finite writes (in progress). 3) UI fallback for nulls. 4) playbook for targeted backfill.

ops-bot: incident INC-2026 status -> resolved.

sam: thanks team. I'll follow up with the customer summary and link to postmortem once ready. :thumbsup:
